rationale: release-cli.yml, release-dry-run.yml and release-path-pr-gate.yml now package the Unix CLI through one shared script (tools/ci/release_package_cli.sh) with the same arguments release-cli always passed. The dry-run and the PR gate gain release-cli's dependency-isolation step, and the PR gate builds and packages, including in merge_group for release-path batches. The packaged file set and package_cli.py are unchanged. No design-import, Chromium, rendering or packaging authority moves; the change only makes the pre-tag gates run the release's own packaging.
